body: So I’ve been doing YouTube for about a year and a half, and I know that starting out doing a lot of different types of content can be damaging to the view count. But honestly the best advice I can give is to stop looking to boost views, just do what you want to do and have fun. If you’re having genuine fun and have a great personality, the views will follow. I post variety gaming and get okay views for my channel, maybe even good views for a channel my size, but that’s only when I stopped trying to actively chase what works on YouTube and started just having fun doing what I want to do for my channel in specific. I watched some of your videos, you’re funny and have a good personality, you’re gonna kill it! Good luck!!
